c1-munkaeropiac-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Guest Workers and the Labour Shortage
c1-munkaeropiac-01.scenario: At a seminar on the labour market in Hungary you are asked about the guest workers who live in the workers' hostels near Tiszaújváros and Iváncsa.
c1-munkaeropiac-01.prompt: Say why employers refer to guest workers and what the critics fear, and set the two views against each other with 'míg egyfelől … addig másfelől'.
cues: Mention what the employers refer to
Mention what the trade unions fear for wages
c1-munkaeropiac-01.target: Míg egyfelől a munkáltatók a betöltetlen állásokra hivatkoznak, addig másfelől a szakszervezetek a hazai bérek alakulásától tartanak.
c1-munkaeropiac-01.english: While on the one hand the employers refer to the vacancies, on the other hand the trade unions fear for how domestic wages develop.
c1-munkaeropiac-01.canDo: I can explain why employers hire guest workers in Hungarian factories and what critics say about wages (*vendégmunkás, munkásszálló, munkaerőhiány*).

c1-munkaeropiac-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Stages of a Change in a Factory
c1-munkaeropiac-02.scenario: At the same seminar you describe how work in a factory can change step by step.
c1-munkaeropiac-02.prompt: Describe three stages of a change in a factory's work with 'kezdetben', 'ezt követően' and 'végül'.
cues: Say what happened in the end
c1-munkaeropiac-02.target: Kezdetben csak egy műszakban dolgoztak, ezt követően bevezették a háromműszakos munkarendet, végül pedig új dolgozókat vettek fel.
c1-munkaeropiac-02.english: At first they worked in only one shift, after this the three-shift schedule was introduced, and in the end new workers were hired.
c1-munkaeropiac-02.canDo: I can describe how assembly-line work is organised (*futószalag-munka, normaemelés, háromműszakos munkarend*).

c1-munkaeropiac-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Platform Work and the KATA Change
c1-munkaeropiac-03.scenario: At the seminar you are asked about delivery couriers in Budapest and the KATA change of 2022.
c1-munkaeropiac-03.prompt: Say what happened to the KATA in 2022 and what the European Union did in 2024, and give its purpose with 'céljából'.
cues: Mention the year of the KATA change
Mention the EU directive and its year
Give the purpose of the directive
c1-munkaeropiac-03.target: 2022 júliusában a parlament egy nap alatt elfogadta a KATA változtatásait. A platformmunkások védelme céljából az Európai Unió 2024-ben irányelvet fogadott el.
c1-munkaeropiac-03.english: In July 2022 parliament adopted the changes to the KATA within one day. For the purpose of protecting platform workers the European Union adopted a directive in 2024.
c1-munkaeropiac-03.canDo: I can describe platform work and the KATA change of 2022, with the year and who said what (*platformkapitalizmus, futár, KATA-adózás*).

c1-munkaeropiac-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Dispute over Strike Rules
c1-munkaeropiac-04.scenario: At the seminar you report the dispute about the strike rules for teachers in 2022.
c1-munkaeropiac-04.prompt: Report what the unions and the government said about the strike rules, and say what some analysts expect, with 'minden valószínűség szerint'.
cues: Give the year of the decree
Give an analysts' forecast and say whose it is
c1-munkaeropiac-04.target: 2022-ben a kormány rendeletben írta elő a 'még elégséges szolgáltatást'. A szakszervezetek szerint ez kiüresítette a sztrájkjogot, egyes elemzők szerint pedig minden valószínűség szerint nő a pályaelhagyók száma.
c1-munkaeropiac-04.english: In 2022 the government laid down 'sufficient service' by decree. According to the unions this emptied the right to strike, and according to some analysts the number of people leaving the profession will in all probability grow.
c1-munkaeropiac-04.canDo: I can describe the dispute over strike rules for teachers in 2022, naming each side's view (*sztrájkjog, vadsztrájk, polgári engedetlenség*).

c1-munkaeropiac-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Commuting to Austria
c1-munkaeropiac-05.scenario: At the seminar you are asked about the people from Sopron and Szombathely who work in Austria.
c1-munkaeropiac-05.prompt: Say why many people commute to Austria and give an analysts' conclusion with 'a fentiek tükrében'.
cues: Give a conclusion and say whose view it is
c1-munkaeropiac-05.target: Sokan ingáznak naponta Ausztriába, mert ott több munkakörben magasabb fizetést remélnek. A fentiek tükrében egyes elemzők a tudásalapú gazdaság erősítését tartják fontosnak.
c1-munkaeropiac-05.english: Many people commute to Austria every day because they hope for higher pay there in many jobs. In the light of the above some analysts consider strengthening the knowledge-based economy important.
c1-munkaeropiac-05.canDo: I can describe commuting from western Hungary to Austria and the debate about wages (*határ menti ingázás, agyelszívás, bérfelzárkózás*).

c1-munkaeropiac-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Labour-Market Debate in Summary
c1-munkaeropiac-consolidation.scenario: You close the seminar on the Hungarian labour market by summing up the debate.
c1-munkaeropiac-consolidation.prompt: Sum up the debate about guest workers and wages in two views, and end with a short conclusion.
c1-munkaeropiac-consolidation.target: Míg egyfelől a munkáltatók munkaerőhiányra hivatkoznak, addig másfelől a szakszervezetek a bérek alakulásától tartanak. A fentiek tükrében a vita még folytatódik.
c1-munkaeropiac-consolidation.english: While on the one hand the employers refer to a labour shortage, on the other hand the trade unions fear for how wages develop. In the light of the above the debate continues.
c1-munkaeropiac-consolidation.canDo: I can describe the labour-market debate about guest workers, naming whose view each is.
